name: Timeline Entry
description: Immutable entry in an append-only Timeline. The Timeline Provider assigns a timestamp that is unique and strictly increasing within the timeline, links the entry to its predecessor, and authenticates actor and available source attribution. A feeder validates, orders, and filters entries before passing eligible events to a processor.

prevEntry.description: Previous entry in the same timeline, normally represented as a pure reference. The first entry may omit this field.

timestamp.description: Microsecond timestamp assigned by the Timeline Provider. It is unique and strictly increasing within this timeline and is the authoritative intra-timeline ordering value. It also supports cross-timeline ordering and completeness windows under the provider profile.

actor.description: Actor attributed as the writer or submitter of this entry.

source.description: Optional provider-authenticated attribution of how the entry was submitted, such as through a browser session, API call, or document request. Source complements actor attribution and does not grant authority by itself. A policy that requires or excludes a source category must treat an absent source as not satisfying that source constraint.

onBehalfOf.description: Optional authority under which actor claims to act for another actor. A feeder validates the concrete authority before delivery when the requested action is not directly eligible through a source channel. Mandate-backed authority uses Mandate/Mandate Authority.

message.description: Message or event recorded by the entry.
